rules.topic: The pumpjack consumes 1024 IF/t while pumping and extracts 15 mB of reservoir fluid per tick (pumpjack_speed, line 66) - a full-rate pumpjack drains about 18000 mB per minute and needs roughly an IE diesel generator quarter to itself
The derrick (the structure that builds the pumpjack's well) consumes 512 IF/t while operating

Crude oil reservoirs (jar datapack defaults): capacity up to 32500000 mB, minimum size 2500000 mB, generation weight 40, trace amount 6 mB - reservoirs are effectively multi-hour supplies at pumpjack rates; other reservoir types (aquifer, lava) are defined the same way in the same folder

The distillation tower, coker unit and hydrotreater take energy and time from their recipe data; the config only carries energy/time modifiers (all default 1.0, lines 88-108) - quote per-recipe costs and fluid ratios from the jar's recipe JSONs (layer 1/2)

source_ref: branch 1.20.1 tip is the release commit for exactly 4.3.1-36b (gradle.properties version_immersivepetroleum=4.3.1-36b; commit message Release 4.3.1-36b). Repo trap: the modern source lives in TwistedGate/ImmersivePetroleum - Flaxbeard/ImmersivePetroleum is frozen at 1.16-era branches
